crossRefs.note: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on…
You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

translations.web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
translations.bsb: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
translations.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
translations.asv: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
